support.reason: v0 has no heap-allocating types (Box/Shared/String/Array) lowered to native code: the runtime allocator seam exists in the ABI spec but no allocating construct is compiled yet (the fixed `[T; N]` is inline and a `Str` is a borrowed view of static data; both allocate nothing). Awaits the allocator ADR. No program can exercise allocation.

ADR-0006's effect seam covers already-open descriptors only (std::rt::write/read_byte) plus process exit; no socket-open effect primitive exists (no socket/bind/listen/accept/connect), so no program can create a connection (ADR-0006, amendment 2). Awaits ADR-0007 or a successor effect ADR.
